verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report of eBay running a 2-region, fully replicated ClickHouse deployment, plus a general remark about robust cluster support. This shows multi-region replication is possible, but nothing documents placing data or replicas near users for low read latency. Missing for 10: first-party docs on multi-region replica placement or Cloud region selection, geo-routing of reads to nearby replicas, latency-oriented global read guidance, and hands-on latency corroboration.
